content:
zoe: FYI the quickstart node sample broke after bumping SDK to v2.3.0-rc. embeddings then rerank gave nonsense ranks. anyone else?

arpit: saw that in CI. sample sends two 3-d vectors but the server trace shows dims interleaved. looks like the batch packer mutated the caller buffer.

lucas: can you paste the request/trace?

zoe: sent:
```json
{
  "model": "embed-lite",
  "inputs": [[0.11,0.12,0.13],[0.21,0.22,0.23]],
  "batching": {"preserve_order": false}
}
```
server saw:
```json
{
  "inputs": [[0.11,0.21],[0.12,0.22],[0.13,0.23]]
}
```

sam: that will make the reranker treat dims as separate docs. bad. two issues here: packer mutates inputs in-place, and we saw duplicate batch POSTs when auth TTL expired mid-send.

arpit: for dup sends: SDK triggers token refresh on 401 and schedules retry, but the batch group isn't cancelled so sometimes the same body is sent twice. logs show back-to-back 200s with same batch_id.

lucas: short fixes: sampleapp should call `const safe = inputs.map(a => a.slice())` and/or set `preserve_order=true`. also add an idempotency/batch_id header for server de-dupe.

sam: long-term: SDK must not mutate caller arrays (clone internally) and the retry path should mark in-flight groups as awaiting auth rather than re-sending. infra can also ignore duplicate batch_id for a brief window.

zoe: also discovered a tiny response rename in rerank: when detailed=true the field is now `score_values` instead of `scores` in some responses; sampleapp parsing crashed. adding migration note.

devex-bot: created issue DEVEX-5201 "embed: packer mutates inputs + auth-retry duplicate batch sends" assigned to @arpit and @lucas.

zoe: I'll open a sampleapp PR with the defensive copy and README note, and link the issue. thanks all.
